title: P3 request_action: arguments
description: Built-in tool request_action: a request for an action from the role actions_may_request. The action arguments are checked by the closed schema of the action manifest after defaults are filled in; the core takes the machine and resources from the catalog, not from a model argument (APR-2). At most 3 requests per task; an identical waiting request returns the existing number.

action.description: Name of an action in the tenant catalog.
